title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 6: the siege of Jerusalem announced, 'Peace, peace' when there is no peace, and the old paths rejected.

questions.text: Who are told to flee for safety out of the middle of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem!"

questions.text: In which town was the trumpet to be blown?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north."

questions.text: As a well produces its waters, what does Jerusalem produce?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her."

questions.text: Like what will they thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies says, "They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine."

questions.text: What do they say while healing the hurt of the people superficially?
questions.explanation: They have healed the hurt of the people superficially, "saying, 'Peace, peace!' when there is no peace."

answers.text: "Peace, peace!" when there is no peace
"All is well!" when ruin is near
"Yahweh is with us!" when he has left
"No sword will come!" when war is at the gates

questions.text: What did Yahweh say the people would find if they walked in the good way, the old paths?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to ask for the old paths and walk in the good way, "and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, 'We will not walk in it.'"

answers.text: A land flowing with milk and honey

questions.text: What did the people answer when the watchmen said, "Listen to the sound of the trumpet"?
questions.explanation: Yahweh set watchmen over them, saying to listen to the sound of the trumpet, but they said, "We will not listen!"

answers.text: "We hear, but we will not go"

questions.text: From where does the frankincense come that Yahweh does not accept?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks, "To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country?"

questions.text: The voice of the people coming from the north country roars like what?
questions.explanation: Of that cruel people it says, "Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses."

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he had made the one he spoke to among his people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way."

answers.text: A refiner's fire and a hammer
A tester of metals and a fortress
